description: This file defines the 'WorkWeek' entity class for the OrangeHRM human resource management system, representing weekly work schedule data with properties for each day of the week and associated ORM mappings.

classes.name: WorkWeek
classes.description: Entity class representing a work week schedule with properties for each day. Includes constants for work week length types, ORM annotations for database mapping, and getter/setter methods for properties.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the work week entity.

methods.description: Retrieves the associated OperationalCountry entity, if any.

methods.name: setOperationalCountry
methods.description: Associates an OperationalCountry entity with this work week.
